title: P761,600 worth of suspected shabu seized in Oriental Mindoro

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Two women were arrested, and around 112 grams of suspected shabu worth an estimated P761,600 were seized in a drug bust operation in Naujan town on Tuesday, authorities said. A 33-year-old assistant cook from Barangay Sto. Niño, Calapan City, and a 36-year-old unemployed woman from Barangay Mahabang Parang in Naujan were detained in the operation conducted by the local police and the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency in Sitio 7, Barangay Sampaguita.
